items.title: Edward "Noon" Johnson Interview, 1960-05-28
items.q: I turned it over to the other boy that played ghetto with Miss Sam.

ctx.x: Well, I played with, since I had bad luck and I had my house caught a fire and I lost everything I had, but I didn't get no more phone and I turned it over to the other boy that played ghetto with Miss Sam. And he had the cause out with Sam's quartet. That's how the cause was playing. I used to have the cause out with Loon's Basooka 3, I got the cause out with 68. He keeps my hand. Yeah. Does Slowdrag play with you quite a bit now?
I heard he did. Well we played, we got two jobs tomorrow night.
